title: ergonomic-retry-templates-and-stream-backpressure-hints-cross-sdk-sync
author: Maya Chen
description: Context: Multiple teams requested a small, composable way to declare retry/backoff behavior and streaming backpressure hints across our Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs. Current patterns are ad-hoc per-SDK and tests repeatedly exercise slightly different default configs which makes cross-language parity tests flaky. Motivation: provide ergonomic, named retry templates (RetryTemplate) and a compact backpressure hint envelope (StreamHint) that SDKs can map to native retry implementations, with minimal caller surface changes. Goals: 1) introduce RetryTemplate presets (optimistic, stable, failfast) with explicit jitter and deadline strategies; 2) add StreamHint metadata that servers and the console can consume to adjust batching and KV-cache warmup policies; 3) keep public client callsites backwards-compatible (optional new param bag) and increment SDKs' minor versions; 4) add cross-sdk interop test harness and CI jobs that validate parity on the presets. Summary of changes: - SDKs: python, typescript, go: add a small RetryTemplate shim and StreamHint type in each SDK; optional "retry_profile" and "stream_hints" params accepted on streaming and non-streaming call helpers; minor ergonomic helpers for building templates (builders in TS/Go, factory helpers in Python). - Runtime/client: add lightweight header mapping so upstream gateway can see StreamHint.x-batch-preference and x-retry-template (this is opt-in; defaults not sent). - Tests: new interop test harness that runs permutations of the three presets across languages and verifies behavior under synthetic latency/failure injected workloads. - Docs: consolidated SDK migration guide, examples for common presets, and release notes. Rollout: staged. 1) Merge SDK changes behind feature flag; 2) enable interop CI and run canary exercises; 3) unflag and bump minor versions (Py 0.22.0, TS 1.14.0, Go 1.8.0). Migration notes: callers may pass retry_profile="stable" or provide a RetryTemplate built from factory helpers; existing callers are unaffected. If callers want server-side batching adjustments they should set stream_hints.batch_preference. Testing & validation: local unit tests per SDK, new cross-language CI job (interop/retry-templates) passing against a synthetic server that injects 5–20% transient errors and randomized latencies. Checklist: - [x] SDK APIs added (Py/TS/Go) - [x] Gateway header mapping implemented - [x] Interop CI job added - [x] Docs and migration guide - [x] Version bump proposals filed Risks & mitigations: Risk: accidental overuse of aggressive retry presets leading to higher throughput and cost. Mitigation: templates include telemetry tags and guardrails; Console will show per-route retry-template usage. Production impact: none by default (feature flags off).

feat(ts): introduce RetryTemplate builder + optional retry_profile param
feat(go): add retry template helpers and stream hints mapping
chore(runtime): map x-retry-template and x-batch-preference headers when present
test: add cross-sdk interop harness and CI workflow
docs: migration guide and examples for retry templates
files_preview: gateway/header_mapper/retry_headers.go: +extract StreamHint and set headers x-retry-template/x-batch-preference
discussion: Avery Kim: Please ensure the default "stable" matches existing backoff windows in production. Reply: Maya Chen: confirmed, stable = current default (exp backoff with full jitter, base 50ms, max 2s, deadline 20s).
Priya Nair: Will console and metrics tag the templates? Reply: Maya Chen: yes, telemetry includes retry.template=stable|optimistic|failfast and stream.hint.batch_preference where present.
Luca Rossi: Can we avoid breaking changes to typed streaming function signatures? Reply: Maya Chen: API change is additive (options bag); samples updated in docs.
release_notes: Add named RetryTemplate presets (optimistic/stable/failfast) and optional StreamHint metadata to SDKs. Backwards-compatible; feature off by default. SDK minor bumps after unflag: Python 0.22.0, TypeScript 1.14.0, Go 1.8.0.
testing_summary: Added unit tests in each SDK to validate template->native mapping and integration tests against a synthetic server that injects controlled failures/latency. New interop CI job executes permutations across languages and preset combinations.
notes_for_backport: No backport required; feature is additive and behind flag. If backporting to stable branches, gate by env var to avoid default header emission.
